design_note: GRAVE V13 component-first production from modular blueprint: separate local origin per mesh and assembly transforms, V10 internal geometry retained in assembled coordinates (rounding <=1e-8m). New independent armor shells built from boundary edge cancellation to prevent V12 broken walls; explicit closed mesh validations on each new armor. 01/02 crown, 03 spine, 04 rear upper, 05/06 cheek, 07 chin, 20/21 shoulder, 22/23 flank, separate mounting blocks. Functional components mapped to V10 existing modules. Blueprint dimensions/IDs not reliable CAD; proportions interpreted visually. Attachment audit and independent part GLB exports requested. No image generation or game integration.

module_exports.source: Generated component blueprint; approximate proportions, not calibrated CAD.
